# Anthem Music

> Anthem Music is a family-centered music school in McKinney, Texas, offering private music lessons, group classes, and live music for events. It serves McKinney, Frisco, Prosper, Plano, Allen, and the greater North Collin County area, with lessons at a downtown McKinney studio and a West McKinney home studio.

## What Anthem offers
- **Private music lessons** for all ages and instruments — guitar, piano, violin, drums, bass, ukulele, banjo, voice, and brass. Every new student starts with a free, no-pressure consultation. Available at the downtown McKinney studio and a West McKinney home studio (convenient for Frisco, Prosper, and Plano families).
- **Group classes** — PreK Music, Youth Group (after-school), and semester-based Homeschool Music classes with fine-arts credit documentation. The first class is free.
- **Live music for events** — professional piano, violin, and guitar performers (solo or ensemble) for weddings, private parties, and special occasions. Private parties are $150/hour (two-hour minimum, $300); wedding ceremonies start at $350. Requests are quoted after Anthem confirms availability.
- **Free student tools** — a browser-based tuner, metronome, and beginner chord library with interactive strumming exercises.
